name: Runway Incursion
definition: Incorrect presence of an aircraft, vehicle or person on the protected area of a surface designated for the landing and takeoff of aircraft. Includes entering or crossing a runway without clearance.

name: Runway Excursion
definition: An aircraft veers off the side of the runway or overruns the end of the runway during takeoff or landing.

name: Abnormal Runway Contact
definition: Any landing or takeoff involving abnormal contact with the runway or landing surface, such as hard landings, bounced landings, tail strikes and wing or nacelle strikes.

name: Loss of Control – Inflight
definition: Loss of aircraft control or an extreme deviation from the intended flight path while in flight, including stalls and upsets.

name: Airprox / ACAS alert / loss of separation / near midair / midair collision
definition: Airprox, ACAS or TCAS alerts, loss of separation, and near or actual midair collisions between aircraft in flight.

name: Turbulence Encounter
definition: In-flight encounter with turbulence, including clear-air, mountain wave, convective and wake turbulence.

name: System/Component Failure – Powerplant
definition: Failure or malfunction of an aircraft system or component related to the powerplant, including engine shutdown, surge, loss of thrust and engine fire.

name: System/Component Failure – Non-Powerplant
definition: Failure or malfunction of an aircraft system or component other than the powerplant, such as flight instruments, pitot-static and air data systems.

name: Bird
definition: Occurrence involving a collision or near collision with birds, including bird ingestion into engines.

name: Icing
definition: Accumulation of snow, ice, freezing rain or frost on aircraft surfaces or sensors that adversely affects control, performance or instrument indications, including ground de-icing issues.

name: Controlled Flight Into or Toward Terrain
definition: In-flight collision or near collision with terrain, water or an obstacle without indication of loss of control, including terrain warnings.

name: Cabin Safety Events
definition: Occurrences in the passenger cabin of transport aircraft, including injuries to passengers or cabin crew and unsecured carts or galley equipment.

name: Navigation Error
definition: Navigating the aircraft incorrectly, including deviations from the cleared route or altitude and landing at the wrong airport.

name: ATM/CNS
definition: Occurrences involving air traffic management or communication, navigation and surveillance services, such as controller errors or clearance misunderstandings.

name: Ground Handling
definition: Occurrences during ground handling operations, such as servicing, loading and towing, including damage from ground equipment.

name: Fire/Smoke (Non-Impact)
definition: Fire or smoke in or on the aircraft, in flight or on the ground, not resulting from an impact.

name: Fuel Related
definition: Occurrences related to fuel quantity, imbalance, contamination or fuel system management.

name: Windshear or Thunderstorm
definition: Flight into windshear or thunderstorm, including microbursts, sudden wind changes and associated loss of airspeed or altitude.

name: Undershoot/Overshoot
definition: A touchdown off the runway surface before the threshold (undershoot) or a landing beyond the runway end that is not an excursion during the roll.

name: Other
definition: Occurrences that do not fit any other category; a holding pool for emerging issues.

name: Loss of Control – Ground
definition: Loss of aircraft control while the aircraft is on the ground, such as a ground loop, nose-over or directional control loss during takeoff or landing roll.

name: Ground Collision
definition: Collision while taxiing to or from a runway in use, with another aircraft, a vehicle, a person or an obstacle.

name: Collision with Obstacle(s) During Takeoff and Landing
definition: Collision with an obstacle during takeoff or landing while airborne, such as trees, wires or terrain near the runway.

name: Low Altitude Operations
definition: Collision or near collision with obstacles or terrain while intentionally operating near the surface, excluding takeoff and landing.

name: Fire/Smoke (Post-Impact)
definition: Fire or smoke resulting from impact.

name: Unintended Flight in IMC
definition: Continued visual flight into instrument meteorological conditions, or loss of visual reference.

name: Collision with Wildlife
definition: Collision with an animal other than a bird on the ground or in the air.

name: Security Related
definition: Criminal or security acts such as hijacking, sabotage or laser attack.

name: Evacuation
definition: An evacuation with injuries, an unnecessary evacuation, or an evacuation hampered by equipment or procedures.

name: Medical
definition: Illness or incapacitation of a crew member or passenger.

name: External Load Related Occurrences
definition: Occurrences during or as a result of external load or sling operations.

name: Aerodrome
definition: Occurrences involving aerodrome design, service or functionality issues.

name: Unknown or Undetermined
definition: Insufficient information exists to categorize the occurrence.
